entries.title: Reactions & ratings, a full Marketplace with auctions, paperwork packs, and the Chapel
items: Gallery, Community and Marketplace: react with ❤️ 👍 🔥 😮 😂 🙏 👏 🌟 (one each per person), rate 1–5 stars, reply to comments, open creator profiles and follow creators. Everything can still be reported and moderated.

Marketplace: list anything you made as a Free download, Give away, Buy now, Make an offer or Auction (start price, optional hidden reserve, minimum increment, 1 hour–30 days, bid history, 2-minute anti-sniping, outbid notices and a winner). All rules are checked on the server.

Listing is always free. A 5% house fee (set by admins) applies only to completed sales, with a clear fee and earnings breakdown. Payments aren’t switched on yet — Buy now, accepted offers and winning bids are commitments only; no card is taken and no money moves.

Paperwork pack (ZIP or PDF) on every listing: certificate of creation with a SHA-256 content fingerprint and timestamp, your licence (All rights reserved, personal, commercial, exclusive or Creative Commons), a fair price guide, sale or auction terms, a bill of sale template, a fee statement and an Australian tax guide.

New pages: Marketplace guidelines, Seller terms, Buyer terms, Auction rules, Fees, Prohibited items and the Australian tax guide (plain-English templates that need a lawyer’s review before real money goes live).

The Chapel — home of Archangel Angelic Faith: a daily reflection, sermons and bedtime stories read aloud, ULTRA writes new ones on any theme, prayers and a moderated prayer wall, hymns that open in the Music Studio, AI faith art, devotional lyric videos, a services calendar and a code of conduct welcoming every faith.

entries.title: New Music Studio (powered by ULTRA) and a public Gallery
items: Music Studio: answer 13 personal questions and ULTRA plans your song — title, lyrics, structure, chords, tempo, key, mood, drum style and lead melody. Quick compose makes one on your device with no AI, and says so.

Archangel music engine: multitrack synths (15 sounds), drum machine (two kits), step grid and piano-roll editing, per-track filter, drive, echo, reverb, pan, mute/solo and a master mixer. Edits play straight away. Download WAV.
Record your own vocals over the song (headphones recommended). There is no AI singing voice — the lead synth plays the vocal melody.
Music videos: five audio-reactive Archangel looks with synced lyrics, phone/YouTube/square shapes, your own background picture, recorded to WebM on your device (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Android).

Gallery: share poems, music, live music videos and pictures publicly. Filter by type, search, like, comment, remix songs, report, and delete your own. Moderated with the same reports and Admin tools as the Community.
Audio and video file uploads in the Gallery switch on after a one-time setup; until then the Gallery shares playable songs and live music videos, which work now.

entries.title: Relevant project plans and correct Full Preview Escape
items: Unknown apps no longer inherit Habit tracker planning defaults. Homework, inventory, bookings and contact-manager requests get relevant screens, fields and workflows; other unknown subjects stay generic until you specify them. Explicit questionnaire choices remain authoritative.

Older unrelated Habit plan metadata is corrected in the Builder from its saved project brief without changing the existing app code or data. Exported project requirements remain based on the saved brief.
The first Escape in expanded Full Preview returns to split view and is consumed before the workspace close handler. A subsequent Escape can close the workspace normally.

entries.title: New build navigation repaired — existing projects stay safe
items: New build is now visible in the Builder, My apps and app editor. Home and sidebar Build an app start fresh instead of reopening the last selected project. Only the workspace selection is reset; projects, versions and drafts are not deleted.
Start fresh and Resume saved planning are separate choices. Drafts open directly in Builder and keep their answers and stage after a reload.

The creation box uses an explicit project-planning path, so a homework planner is not turned into calendar tasks. General chat also recognises explicit “build me a homework planner” requests; ordinary homework task planning still works.
Direct fresh entry: #/builder/new. A questionnaire can also be opened with #/builder/new?idea= followed by a URL-encoded project description.

entries.title: Personal planning, saved project briefs, finished-project ZIPs and Archangel artwork
items: ULTRA’s existing build questions now offer detailed planning from a 60-question bank, adapted for apps, websites, full-stack prototypes and games. Seven manageable stages cover people, journeys, priorities, data, design, accessibility, delivery and acceptance checks. Quick essentials is still available.

Answers save on this device. Go back, skip remaining questions, save and pause, then resume. Starter choices already supplied are carried into the brief instead of being asked again. Conditional follow-ups cover demo roles and future API requirements.

Review and edit the brief before building: must-have for version one, optional features for later, acceptance checks and honest limitations. Planning is local and adds no AI calls to the repaired shared-generation path.

The personalised brief feeds the build and editable Plan, stays with the saved project and guides later AI edits. In Plan you can edit future requirements, download the brief or reuse the answers for a new build.

Preview has a prominent Download project ZIP button after saving. It packages actual generated HTML, CSS, JavaScript, README, file manifest and saved plan; server files are included only when the project contains them. No pretend AI attachment or automatic download.
Full Preview on a computer can now expand out of the narrow split column. Tests that time out say “Test incomplete”, not “All checks passed”.
Original lightweight Archangel wings-and-constellations artwork now appears in the one-box create area, planning, starter studio and Game Studio. No external assets or tracking.

entries.title: AI timeout repair: working shared route, honest failures and retry
items: The shared AI now uses a verified current model instead of an overloaded alias and retired fallbacks. Its server bounds provider attempts and returns useful errors instead of waiting indefinitely.
Shared builds now use one complete-code request after your local plan, followed by a local preview check. They no longer spend several requests on a separate AI spec and milestones.
AI errors distinguish timeout, connection, server, key, model and request-limit problems. A busy shared AI no longer silently switches to an unrelated AI service.
Failed AI builds stop clearly: no basic template is substituted and called a success. Retry same request & choices is in the build Log. Settings → ULTRA → Test checks the code-generation connection.
Interrupted streams and stream errors are caught. Partial output stays in Code with a download button; the latest draft is also kept best-effort in this browser tab across reloads.
Failed edits keep the existing project. A failed local preview check does not replace it. New versions with test warnings say what still needs attention.

entries.title: Smarter ULTRA game building, sturdier games, Test and Undo in Preview
items: ULTRA now recognises a game request and plans it as a game. The brief covers touch and keyboard controls, a game loop that runs the same speed on any screen, title, pause, level, win and game-over screens, Play again, a score bar and a saved high score.

After building a game, ULTRA tests it as a game: it checks the loop, touch controls, keyboard, game over, restart, pause and phone layout. It no longer asks a game to grow app tabs. Anything missing goes into its fix loop, which stops after 2 rounds.
When you change a game, ULTRA is told to keep its controls, pause and Play again working. If a change fails its check, your app stays as it was.

Game Creation Engine fixes: games pause when you switch apps (and held keys are released), tapping the screen resumes, R restarts, and a stray tap right at game over no longer restarts the game straight away.
Preview → 🧪 Test runs the same hidden check ULTRA uses and lists what passed. If something is wrong, Ask ULTRA to fix sends exactly what was found.
Preview → ↩️ Undo goes back to the previous version in one tap, saved as a new version, so nothing is lost.

entries.title: Better Preview and Customise for your projects
items: Preview has Phone, Tablet and Full sizes, and it remembers the one you last used. There's also a Reload button.
If your app hits a real error while it runs, Preview shows the message and gives you an “Ask ULTRA to fix” button, which sends ULTRA those exact errors.
🛠 Customise for template apps, websites and full-stack projects: change the name, look, layout, tone and features, then Apply. You get a new version and keep what you'd added.
🛠 Customise for games made with the Game Creation Engine: change difficulty, levels, lives (up to 9), scoring, look, the player, enemy and collectable emoji, and the toggles. Your high score is kept.
Preview now has a one-tap ZIP download, and Install is now called “Open / Install” (it opens your app on its own page).
Clearer notes: Preview data is saved on this device only, the sign-in is a demo, and the full-stack Node server is a starting point, not a secure production backend.

entries.title: Real apps, websites, full-stack builds and a bigger Game Creation Engine
items: Builder → “Start from a template”: choose App, Website or Full-stack, pick from 19 templates, then set the look, layout, tone and features (dark mode, sign-in, search, charts, forms, export, FAQ, reviews, pricing, blog).
⚡ Create now builds a real multi-page project instantly and for free; it opens in Preview and is saved in My apps. ✨ Build with ULTRA sends the same choices to the AI.
Full-stack templates (tasks, shop, bookings, CMS, helpdesk) include a REST API. Preview uses a built-in mock; Export the ZIP and run npm start to get the real Node server and a db.json.

Game Studio has a new Game Creation Engine with 11 playable genres: shooter with boss fights, brick breaker, sky jumper, flappy, runner, snake, asteroids, pong vs AI, catcher, maze chase and tap reflex.

Game options: difficulty, levels (or endless), lives, scoring, look, your own player and enemy emoji, power-ups, boss levels, sound and an on-screen touch pad. ▶ Play now gives you the game straight away.
8 more AI game templates (tower defence, RPG, survival, rhythm, memory, mini golf, idle clicker, word game), plus more build questions for websites, apps and arcade games.

Angelic Intelligence: a deep-thinking mode alongside ULTRA (Settings → ULTRA)

5 new space themes, AI models guide, fresh ideas every visit

Step-by-step guides: build with AI, test AI-built apps, add AI to your own app safely, teach and train AI
Every guide also opens as its own web page under /resources/
Keys stay in Settings only — never in code, chat or shared apps

Roadmap: what's shipped and what's next (AI resources, hardware guides, paid testers, Stripe)
Platform overview: how Builder, ULTRA, Community and Marketplace fit together, with schematics
Builder guide for blueprints, looks and themes

items: Plugins library: 52 new working tools in 6 groups (Everyday, Info & web, Create, Developer, Voice & media, Life & learning) plus the 7 organisers — search, filter, install/switch off
Weather, currency, Wikipedia, dictionary, news, GitHub, holidays, countries, ISS — free, no sign-up APIs

QR maker & scanner, palettes, logo & meme makers, emoji & icon pickers, charts, passwords, Markdown, JSON, regex, hashes, voice, recorder, image resizer, journal, flashcards, quizzes, mind maps, translator and writers
ULTRA answers instantly with installed plugins ("weather in Perth", "convert 5 km to miles", "define serendipity") and builds them into your apps
xAI Grok can be your ULTRA key provider (choose the model; the key stays on this device)
Books download as a real PDF
Share links are much smaller, so bigger apps fit
New Archangel artwork across the app

entries.title: Own it, share it, write books
items: Export any app as a ZIP with the full source (index.html, styles.css, app.js, manifest, icons, README for GitHub Pages / Netlify / Vercel) plus a standalone HTML, and optionally its data
Export everything + Export all my data — you own your code
Share an app by link (the app travels inside the link) — opens on its own page, 'Save to my Archangel'
Community: showcase, play others' apps, shared projects by link (demo mode)
Marketplace: free listings and give-aways (selling and donations coming soon)
Ownership & docs: record of authorship with a code fingerprint, licence picker, copyright notice, terms & privacy templates, publishing checklist
Books: plan chapters with ULTRA, write, cover, export EPUB and PDF
Welcome tour, searchable Settings, cloud backup via your phone's share sheet, new Archangel art

entries.title: The Builder, My apps and fresh ideas
items: New Builder page: a detailed plan first (screens, features, data, flows, design, milestones), then it builds milestone by milestone by itself
Tabs: Plan, Build log, Code (live, with line numbers), Preview and Details
Apps now look like real phone apps: splash screen, app bar, bottom tabs, cards — and are checked for empty screens
My apps: change an app with ULTRA, edit its code, rename it, new icon, versions and go back, duplicate, delete
Lots of new ideas to tap, a fresh set every visit (written by your AI when you have a key)
Settings → Updates: see your version, check for updates and what's new
